Why would anyone fear holding on to wealth?

Kevin Trudeau says people who struggle with money often carry a hidden belief that having it makes you a target. They expect to be lied to, used, or left by friends.

He says wealthy people believe the opposite: money is safe, and they are the right person to have it because they will do good with it. He points to Andrew Carnegie and his libraries as an example.

Which belief do you notice in yourself?
